tagline: Insurance that sees the storm coming
brief: A multi-insurer agricultural insurance platform for agri SMEs and farmers: policies ranked by predicted risk, storm alerts, satellite damage proof and automatic payouts once the adjuster approves.
criteria: Success: avoids shields, umbrellas, leaves and AI clichés; reads at 32 px; works in one colour and reversed on green.

concepts.name: Field Watch
concepts.idea: Rows of a field with a sun rising at the corner: AiGRI sees what is coming.
rationale: Stepped rows read as land seen from above, echoing the satellite view
The sun is the forecast and the alert; it reappears as the dot of the i
One radius, one bar height, exact angles; a simpler two-row cut for 16 px

recommendation: Field Watch: grounded, ownable in a category of shields and leaves, and it extends into patterns (rows) and alerts (the sun).
next_steps: Swap the logo into the landing page
